<thought>Carbonyl carbons typically appear in the 13C NMR spectrum at chemical shifts above ~165 ppm (ketones ~190‑210 ppm, esters/carboxylic acids ~165‑185 ppm). The provided spectrum shows the highest shift at 160.80 ppm and no signals in the carbonyl region, indicating the molecule lacks carbonyl carbons. Therefore, the number of C=O groups is zero.</thought>
